ask: The client loved the preview. Make the YouTube video public.
before: list-workspace-posts with the YouTube account_ids showed the YouTube video Scheduled for Fri 10:00 am, unlisted. The reply said: "Making it public sends this scheduled post back for your yes, and the client's yes no longer counts. Change it?" The user said yes.

steps.why: First, where privacy was set. If metadata.platformSpecific.youtube holds privacy_status, that value wins and a details change would do nothing: change it with save-post platform_specific instead. Here it isn't there.

The decision: public now that the preview is approved, and subscribers told this time. Only the keys that change. A real change on a scheduled post sends it back to waiting; the result carries sent_back_for_review, approval_reset and a message, and reports the youtube row.
Read back privacy_status public before saying it is set.

say: Changed for Acme: the YouTube video will go up public and subscribers will be notified. That sent the post back to waiting for your yes, so it won't go out Fri 10:00 am until you approve it again. Approve it now?
never: Changing it before saying it needs a new yes.
